title: batch.yield_variance_unfavorable.v1 | batch.yield_variance_favorable.v1
description: Two event types, not one with a sign field, so the ledger's fixed-Dr/Cr-per-event-type posting_rules model never needs conditional direction logic (see docs/SDD.md §3.C and infra/postgres/migrations/008_manufacturing.sql). Unfavorable: Dr Manufacturing Variance Expense / Cr WIP. Favorable: Dr WIP / Cr Manufacturing Variance Expense. Emitted only when |consumption_value - output_value| >= 0.005; an exact-zero variance emits neither.

variance_value.description: abs(consumption_value - output_value) — always positive; direction is carried by which event_type was emitted, not by sign.
